messages:
Ivy: quick proposal: add a 'fast-intake' quickcheck that runs in PRs. single cheap pass that validates manifest integrity, tokenizer sanity, sentinel-token stability, tiny perf probes, and a semantic fallback on a 10-item goldset.
Sam: good. target latency/cost? must be PR friendly.
Ivy: aim <10s wall, ~0.1 GPU-min when registry cache hit. run on tiny-pool; skip quant if prequantized in registry.
Rafael: sampling seqlens? long seqs can hide problems.
Ivy: default samples: 16, 256, 1536. if declared max_seq > 1536 add it. we do a single forward per seqlen with deterministic decode (seed=42, temp=0, top_k=1) and decode max_new=2. keeps cost bounded.
Priya: tokenizer diffs trigger a lot of noise. how do we avoid false alarms?
Ivy: two-stage check: (1) tokenizer checksum + special-token presence/ids (eos,bos,pad,unk) immediate fail if missing; (2) token-match metrics and embedding cosine on goldset as fallback. only hard-fail if both token and embed signals are bad.
Sam: quant parity concerns: float vs q5/q8 may legit differ.
Ivy: compare float vs best-available quant(s). compute token_match and embed_cosine. pass rules: embed_cos>=0.93 OR token_match>=0.9. otherwise tag for full-smoke.
ci-bot: validator/fast-intake queued for PR #2204 on tiny-pool :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Rafael: telemetry hooks? platform needs perf signals to tune reserves.
Ivy: publish token-level p50/p95 per sampled seqlen, peak RSS estimate, and an artifact_cache_hit boolean + quant_cache_key in fingerprint. also exercise KV cache warmup in harness.
Priya: failure flow? auto-rollback?
Ivy: on FAIL we label PR `fast-intake:fail` and attach a compact fingerprint + diff. owner triages. for perf blips we expose a one-click pin to previous stable quant artifact while owner fixes. also provide `fast-intake:ignore-ttl` label for temporary known exceptions that auto-expire.
Sam: CLI and integration?
Ivy: prototype CLI: `fast-intake run --manifest m.json --gold gold.json --out fp.txt`. fingerprint is a short CSV-like string for parsers, e.g. `fp=sha256:abcd;seqlens=16,256,1536;perf_ms=5,38,180;tok_match=0.95;embed=0.97;cache_hit=true`.
Rafael: please include MODEL_INTAKE_SEED env var in docs and a small jitter in CI scheduler to avoid spikes.
Ivy: noted. I'll push a minimal prototype + unit tests that use registry cache to avoid spend. tagging @Priya for sentinel-token checks and @Rafael for seqlen thresholds.
Priya: will review this afternoon. :eyes:
